references.text: Matt 8:16 also mentions that Jesus healed many who were possessed by demons and all who were sick, demonstrating Jesus' healing power and authority over disease and demons, similar to Matt 4:24.

In Matt 9:35 we read that Jesus went around in all the towns and villages, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every disease and every affliction. This verse shows Jesus' comprehensive healing ministry, as described in Matt 4:24.

Luke 4:40 tells of when the sun set, and all who had people sick with various diseases brought them to him. He laid his hands on each one of them and healed them, which resembles the description of Jesus' healing ministry in Matt 4:24.

In Luke 6:17-19 we read about a large crowd that came to hear Jesus and be healed of their diseases. Those troubled by unclean spirits were healed. All tried to touch him, for power went out from him and healed everyone. This shows Jesus' healing power over diseases and demons, parallel to Matt 4:24.

Acts 5:15-16 describes how people carried the sick out into the streets and laid them on beds and mats, so that when Peter passed by, at least his shadow might fall on some of them. People also flocked from the towns around Jerusalem, and they were all healed. This shows the early church's continued healing ministry in Jesus' name, as a continuation of the healing ministry of Jesus described in Matt 4:24.
